overview: This study note examines the reasons why Israel rejected the message, the remedy for that rejection, and the resulting consequences.

topics.title: Reasons for Rejection
topics.summary: Israel rejected the message for several reasons, including not feeling the need for salvation, being zealous for God by making their own traditions, and being proud and self-righteous.
key_points: Did not feel the need for salvation; thought they were fine and could save themselves.
Made their own traditions and worshipped them instead of God.
Were proud and self-righteous, refusing to listen and learn.
Misunderstood their own law, which only leads the sinner to the savior.
Obedience must be in the heart, not just outward.

topics.title: Remedy for Rejection
topics.summary: The remedy for rejection involves using a missionary program and understanding that believing and obeying are not interchangeable, emphasizing that one must first hear.
key_points: Believing and obeying are not interchangeable.
To believe one must first hear.

topics.title: Results of Rejection
topics.summary: The rejection of Israel resulted in Israel being guilty, the message being shared with Gentiles, and God still yearning for His people.
key_points: Israel is guilty because they did hear.
The message is shared with Gentiles due to Israel's rejection.
God still yearns for His people.
